messages:
jess: RC created: v2026.3.0-rc1 from branch release/2026.3.0. Target promo window 05:00 PT. DB migration is two-step (schema add -> backfill). Seeking quick signoff and if anyone wants a 30m delay /cc @matt @priya @kai

matt: ack — checking the migration scripts now. what's the rollback play if step 2 fails?

jess: rollback plan: abort migration, run revert script `scripts/db/revert_2026_3.sh`, pin traffic to v2026.2.9 for 15m, run automated validation. If revert fails within 15m fallback to logical restore from snapshot (T-30m).

priya: can we delay promo by 30m? QA hit a 500 on embeddings for long inputs in canary run.

jess: saw 2/300 errors in canary, looks tokenization-related. proposal: extend canary 15m and run smoke + extended QA. If error rate <0.5% after extension we proceed. Delay ok if @sheryl signs off.

sheryl: I can run load smoke at 04:40 PT and sign off after results. moving to holdable window if needed :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: DeployBot: RC v2026.3.0-rc1 queued for canary in pool-us-east-1 | step=canary-start | status=in-progress

jess: release notes snippet:```
- v2026.3.0-rc1
  - runtime: improved kv-cache eviction + new tokenization fix
  - flags: new-kv-cache (gradual-on)
  - migrations: add_users_props (two-step, backfill)
  - rollback: revert script available at scripts/db/revert_2026_3.sh
```

matt: add quantization-profile note: changed default profile -> ~6% memory delta, call it out in notes.

priya: QA running long-inputs stress (10k tokens). ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary results: 300 reqs, 2 errors (0.67%), p95=210ms. Action required: extend canary?

kai: sheriff here — holding until QA finishes. If errors reproduce prepare rollback. I'll stay on-call for the next hour.

jess: extending canary 15m. enabling low-threshold prom alerts for latency/5xx. pin candidate tag v2026.3.0-rc1. feature flag new-kv-cache set to gradual-on; fallback to old-cache on surge.

sheryl: load smoke passed in my env. QA please confirm after extended run :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary extended | end_time set | monitoring hooks enabled

matt: decision rule: if error_rate > 0.5% after extension -> rollback. else promote to staged 20% -> 50% -> 100% per plan.

priya: tests finished: no new errors in extended window. will post a short summary.

priya: summary: 2 errors in first 10m, none in following 20m. p95 stable. QA signs off for promotion.

jess: Promotion plan: 20% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (15m). rollback gates: error-rate >1% or p95 >400ms. anyone object?

kai: no objections. I'm oncall and will monitor. go ahead.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: promotion started | step=staged-20pct | scheduled

deploy-bot: DeployBot: staged-20pct complete | metrics nominal

deploy-bot: DeployBot: staged-50pct complete | metrics nominal

deploy-bot: DeployBot: rollout complete | RC promoted to prod | release-tag=v2026.3.0

jess: Released. I'll update full release notes and add a short post-release checklist. Thanks all :tada:
